title: AFKStation
description: Lightweight AFK mod that makes idle time cinematic, hides chat on request, shows an AFK timer, caps FPS, and instantly returns to gameplay when you move.

![AFKStation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/85223e053b84762d29ee7219cbf20ab23ec221d5.png)

# AFK Station - Make idle time cinematic!

**AFK Station** turns idle moments into smooth cinematic camera shots, so your world still looks alive while you are away.

Now available on **Fabric**, **NeoForge** and **Forge** for **Minecraft 26.2**. **Quilt** are planned. Client-side only.

## ✨ Features

- **Cinematic AFK camera** with 12 styles:
  - Angle
  - Journey
  - Orbit
  - Halo
  - Spiral
  - Isometric
  - Parallax
  - Low Angle
  - Figure Eight
  - Vertical Sweep
  - Scenic Scout
  - Life Focus
- **Smooth camera motion** with safe framing and ground clearance
- **Close or wide camera framing**
- **Custom camera speed** up to 5.00x
- **Automatic style shuffle** while AFK
- **Optional warning before style shuffle**
- **AFK timer HUD** with:
  - title and timer toggles
  - scale controls
  - top, bottom, center, and custom positions
  - optional vanilla HUD hiding while AFK
- **AFK session history** with:
  - start date and time
  - duration
  - camera style
  - manual or auto trigger
  - up to 20 saved entries
  - next and back page controls
  - optional auto delete for old history
- **Automatic AFK detection** based on movement, mouse, hotbar, and key input
- **AFK countdown** before activation
- **Optional chat hiding** while AFK
- **AFK FPS cap** to reduce resource usage while idle
- **AFK render distance override** while idle
- **Optional AFK FOV override**
- **Optional AFK volume reduction**
- **Warning sound** before AFK starts
- **Clean in-game settings menu**
- **Client-side only**: no server install required

## ⌨️ Default Keybinds

- **N**: Toggle AFK Station
- **M**: Open settings
- **B**: Force AFK on/off
- **V**: Switch camera style

Category: **AFK Station**. All keybinds are remappable.

## 🔧 Requirements

- **Minecraft**: 26.2
- **Loaders**:
  - Fabric Loader + Fabric API
  - Forge
  - NeoForge
  - Quilt *(planned)*
- **Java**: 21+
- **Environment**: Client-only

## ⚙️ Default Settings

- **AFK timeout**: 15 seconds
- **AFK countdown**: 5 seconds
- **AFK FPS cap**: 30
- **AFK FOV**: 30
- **AFK render distance**: 6 chunks
- **Camera**: enabled
- **Camera style**: Angle
- **Camera speed**: 1.00x
- **Style shuffle**: enabled
- **HUD**: enabled
- **HUD anchor**: Top Right
- **Warning sound**: enabled
- **Chat hide**: enabled by default
- **AFK volume reduction**: disabled by default
- **History auto delete**: enabled by default

## 📖 Usage

1. Press `M` to open the settings menu.
2. Configure AFK delay, countdown, FPS cap, render distance, FOV, camera style, HUD position, audio, chat behavior, and history behavior.
3. Wait for AFK to activate automatically, or press `B` to force it manually.
4. Move, look around, or press input keys to instantly leave AFK mode.
5. Open **History** to review recent AFK sessions.
